# تَصَبْصَبْتِ (taṣabṣabti) /ta.sˤab.sˤab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَبْصَبَ (taṣabṣaba)
# تَصَبْصَبَتْ (taṣabṣabat) /ta.sˤab.sˤa
